Komamura slashes an enemy with Tenken 5 times, dealing DMG equal to 468% of ATK. During the 5th basic attack, Tengen Myo-oh attacks alongside Komamura, gaining 1 stack of Build Up. ~~Myo-oh Slash~~ Bankai State

 While Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh is on the field, Komamura can't release Flash Step or counter, and his HP won't drop below 1.

rationale: Sajin Komamura lands in Tier C because the kit's payoff doesn't keep pace with the investment it asks for — they can still carry specific content, but stronger options usually want the same resources. As the team's damage engine, every recommendation on this page optimizes for one thing: the biggest hits landing inside the kit's burst windows. The Strike damage type also matters here: content weak to it is where this build over-performs its tier, and content resistant to it is where you should bench accordingly.

The recommended set — Hidden Wisdom (3) — is chosen for how the set bonus lines up with the kit's actual damage profile, not because it's generically strong. Main stats go 1: Strike DMG > ATK%  •  2: Crit Rate  •  3: ATK% > Ult Charge Rate for the same reason: they feed what the kit multiplies. Crit DMG and Crit Rate lead the substat priority because they multiply together — once Crit Rate is high enough to land reliably, every point of Crit DMG scales the whole kit, which flat ATK can't match. Standard Banner SSR Strike Tactic.

We call B0 the stopping point because that's where the boundary curve bends: the levels up to it unlock the pieces the kit is actually balanced around, while the levels past it mostly buy stat percentages at dupe prices.
The featured rotation ("Giant Slam") is ordered the way it is to stack the kit's multipliers before the big hits land — the sequence matters more than the buttons.
Bond priority starts with ATK Bond because it feeds the stat the rest of this page is built around — later bonds are nice-to-haves, this one changes the math.

As with everything on this page, these calls come from community testing plus the wiki's numbers — when the data changes (balance patches, new stamps, better testing), the recommendations and this reasoning get updated together.
